newsitem.title: USA: CNA forms professional employment group.
newsitem.headline: CNA forms professional employment group.

text.p: CNA Financial Group said Thursday it formed a new professional employer company, CNA UniSource Inc.

The new company "marks our entry into providing professional administrative services as an alternative for businesses that wish to concentrate their time and resources on the competitive insights and initiatives that are at the center of what they do," said Dennis Chookaszian, chairman and chief executive officer of CNA.
Michael Kooken was named president of CNA UniSource, which is based in Chicago.
He previously served as senior financial officer for several CNA operating areas.
CNA said the unit has reached an agreement with Interlogic Systems Inc to serve as its payroll services provider.
